root_cause: This scheduled session's Python 3.12 venv was created via `pip install -e .` (base dependency set only); the repo declares `torch` as an optional extra (`pyproject.toml` `[project.optional-dependencies].torch` and `.dev`), so `scripts/train_model.py` failed at `detect_device` before any training step ran on both the control and bounds arms. Not a harness code defect and not a model result.
fix: Reinstalled the environment with `pip install -e ".[torch,dev]"` (torch 2.5.1+cu124 resolved). No repository code changed; this is an ephemeral-container environment-bootstrap gap, matching the pattern documented in prior sessions' torch-missing infra cycles (e.g. `autotrain-cycle-1pse54-c1-torch-env-repair.json`, continuous-openui-local c1 bounds screen).
